annotations.title: Request a first conversation with CodeAtlas

description: Submit a first-conversation request to CodeAtlas on behalf of a person. Sends an email to the CodeAtlas team. Requires an OAuth Bearer token with scope api:write (see https://codeatlas.com.br/auth.md). Only call this after the person asked you to contact CodeAtlas and gave you their name and email.

email.description: The person's email address. CodeAtlas replies here.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. 8 to 128 printable ASCII characters. Reusing it with the same arguments replays the first result instead of sending a second email.

locale.description: Optional. Reply language. Defaults to pt-BR.

message.description: What the person wants to discuss, 10 to 2000 characters.

service_slug.description: Optional. The service the person is interested in.

name: codeatlas_request_contact
